Rate of Interest on various Retail Loans Linked with Baroda Repo Linked Lending Rate [BRLLR] w.e.f. 08.10.2026

In terms of guidelines issued by Reserve Bank of India regarding implementation of External Benchmark Based Lending rates. Bank has introduced Baroda Repo Linked Lending Rate (BRLLR) in respect of all Retail Lending products w.e.f 01.10.2019

RATE OF INTEREST ON VARIOUS LOANS LINKED WITH BARODA REPO LINKED LENDING RATE (BRLLR)- w.e.f. 08.10.2026

For Retail Loans applicable BRLLR is 8.15% w.e.f. 08.10.2026 (Current RBI Repo Rate: 5.50% + MarkUp/Base Spread 2.65%).

Please contact your base branch for conversion of Rate of Interest from MCLR to BRLLR

  • Fixed ROI is 2% above applicable ROI.
  • At present BRLLR is 7.90% and Strategic Premium is 0.25%

Rate of Interest for Retail Loans based on Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rate (MCLR) w.e.f. 01.04.2016.

In terms of RBI guidelines, effective from 01.04.2016, pricing of all rupee loans and advances linked to Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rate (MCLR).

Rate of Interest under all Retail Loans are linked to 1 year MCLR from 1st April, 2016.

Existing borrowers of the Bank shall have an option to switch over from Base Rate system to interest rates linked to MCLR (other than Fixed Rate Loans). Borrowers willing to switch over to the MCLR based interest rate may contact the respective branch.
